summary: Correct the existing production record to the bounded 2025 Project Lotus sale-recapitalization. Direct manager, advisor, trade and LEI evidence supports Fengate/Fund IV and Montecito as current owners at undisclosed stakes, FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC as the transaction vehicle, and a closed-active state. Keep the separate 24-facility Fengate-MedCraft portfolio outside this record.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Fengate reports 16 facilities in 10 states while Newmark reports 18 properties in 11 states; the public sources do not fully reconcile that difference.
The complete title-entity schedule and exact Fengate/Montecito ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
The exact portfolio-wide legal closing date is not publicly disclosed beyond the late-October/early-November 2025 closing and announcement evidence.
